policy: Empty but well-defined. Fields are added ONLY when obtained from authorized first-party reports (Amazon Associates reports). No conversion score or revenue forecast is ever computed or presented here. Every entry carries a dated provenance trail.

schema.timestamp: ISO-8601 date/time of the observed event
schema.source: authorized first-party report name and report ID (e.g., Amazon Associates Performance Report)
schema.channel: organic | direct | social | email | paid | referral
